changelog:
Initial release for "AI大模型专家｜短剧动态分镜与预演":

- Enables scriptwriters, studios, brands, and content teams to convert creative ideas, scripts, character designs, or reference videos into short drama and comic videos.
- Supports dynamic storyboard, animatic, previs, and video preview generation tailored for domestic and overseas platforms.
- Unified workflow integrating asset upload, real-time model config, cost/speed/success routing, and results download via AI-HIVE.
- Offers tools for story/character/scene boards, mirror-by-mirror video generation, and effective multi-platform adaptation.
- Includes workflow scripts for blueprint creation, text-to-video, image-to-video, reference-based generation, and task management.
- Emphasizes compliance: ensures copyright, character consistency, fact accuracy, subtitle safety, and commercial readiness.
